adds.title: Côte d'Ivoire | Country Page — Human Rights Watch
adds.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. HRW's Côte d'Ivoire country page contains no document, case or report on transgender prisoners: 'LGBT Rights' appears only as a topic-facet link, and no HRW publication is listed on where trans detainees are housed (birth-sex vs identity placement), special units, or solitary/segregation practice in Ivorian prisons.

records.note: No prison-housing data found for Côte d'Ivoire within budget. enwiki REST full-text search 'Côte d'Ivoire transgender prison' returned no trans-prisoner article (top hits: LGBTQ rights in Africa, LGBTQ rights in Niger, LGBTQ people and Islam — none records trans-prisoner placement in CIV). HRW World Report 2025 Côte d'Ivoire chapter URL returned HTTP 404 (no such chapter); US State Dept 2023 report on Côte d'Ivoire returned a 'Technical Difficulties' error page (not retrievable). Fetched HRW country page shows no coverage of trans prisoners or prison-housing placement for CIV. No data found on birth-sex vs identity placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice; prior batch sources (NYT Oct 2024 'hunt' wave, UNDP Resolution 275 review, State Dept 2023) contain no prison-placement content for trans detainees.

adds.title: World Report 2025: Mali — Human Rights Watch
adds.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. The HRW World Report 2025 Mali chapter (Events of 2024) covers the junta's rule, counterterrorism sweeps (arbitrary arrest of 25 people in Ouro Fero village, Nara region) and an ICC arrest warrant, but contains no transgender-specific content and no information on prison placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners.

records.note: No prison-housing data found for Mali within budget. enwiki REST full-text search 'Mali transgender prison' returned no trans-prisoner article (top hits: Timeline of LGBTQ history 21st century, Trans-exclusionary radical feminism, Ibtissame Lachgar — the latter's 'MALI Movement' is Moroccan, not the country; none records trans-prisoner placement in MLI). Fetched HRW World Report 2025 Mali chapter (verified, 139KB) contains no trans/LGBTI/prison-placement content; US State Dept 2023 report on Mali returned a 'Technical Difficulties' error page (not retrievable). The Dec 2024 criminalisation of same-sex conduct (in force 13 Dec 2024) creates new imprisonment risk for LGBTQ people generally, but no document records housing placement for trans prisoners in Malian detention. No data found on birth-sex vs identity placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice.
